name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my house before siding painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my house before siding painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, preparing your home before painters arrive helps ensure a smooth and efficient process. We recommend clearing the perimeter of your house by moving outdoor furniture, potted plants, and decorations at least 5-10 feet away. Trim any overgrown shrubs or tree branches that are touching the siding. We also ask that you secure pets indoors and ensure access to outdoor water spigots. Our team will handle the draping and protection of landscaping and non-movable items.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before painters arrive, clear the perimeter of your house, move outdoor items, trim overgrown foliage, secure pets, and ensure access to outdoor water. Our team handles draping.
